item.title: City of Woodstock Aquatics Coordinator becomes 3rd person to file lawsuit after separate accidents at Algonquin adventure park
item.description: The City of Woodstock Aquatics Coordinator is the third person to file a lawsuit against an adventure park in Algonquin, with the plaintiffs all alleging they suffered injuries in separate foam pit accidents.
